Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md first.

We are building a three-service demo application that will be broken
deliberately, live, in front of an audience. It must fail in
reproducible, immediately-reversible ways without any rollout.

Objective
---------
Build three small Go services forming one request path:
  frontend -> api -> backend

Requirements

1. Language: Go 1.22+. Single module at app/. Layout:
     cmd/frontend, cmd/api, cmd/backend
     internal/chaos, internal/telemetry, internal/logging, internal/server

2. Every service listens on :8080 and serves:
     GET /          normal request path; calls the next service in the chain
     GET /healthz   liveness
     GET /readyz    readiness
     GET /metrics   Prometheus exposition (promhttp default registry)
     GET /chaos     runtime behaviour control, see (3)

3. /chaos?mode=<ok|slow|error|dns> flips behaviour immediately, in-process,
   no restart. Store the mode in an atomic.Value. Modes:
     ok     normal path
     slow   sleep 2s before responding
     error  return HTTP 500 with a plausible error body
     dns    resolve "backend.typo.svc.cluster.local" (deliberately wrong)
            and return HTTP 502 if it fails. Log the DNS error.

   The endpoint must return 200 and take effect before the next request.

4. OpenTelemetry, via the official Go SDK:
   - otelhttp.NewHandler for inbound
   - otelhttp.NewTransport for outbound
   - OTLP/gRPC exporter, endpoint from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
   - Resource service.name from OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
   - Context propagation so frontend's span is the parent of api's span,
     and api's is the parent of backend's.
   - If OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is unset, log a warning and continue.
     Do not block startup, do not crash.

5. Logging: log/slog with a JSON handler, stdout only. Every line includes:
     ts, level, service, trace_id, span_id, msg
   plus error when present. Pull trace_id and span_id from the active OTel
   span so Loki and Tempo can be correlated.

6. Kubernetes labels on workloads, exactly:
     app: frontend | app: api | app: backend
   These keys are load-bearing — CiliumNetworkPolicy selectors depend on
   them. Do not rename or add variants.

Out of scope
------------
Dockerfiles, CI, Helm charts, Kubernetes manifests, the load generator.
Those are separate tasks.

Deliverables
------------
- app/go.mod and go.sum
- app/cmd/*/main.go
- app/internal/*/...
- app/README.md  build, run locally, and the /chaos endpoint
- app/Makefile   targets: build, test, docker-build, run-all

Acceptance
----------
`make build` produces three binaries. Running all three locally with no
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT set produces three running processes that
respond to /healthz and log a single warning each. Then:
  curl 'localhost:8080/chaos?mode=slow' && time curl localhost:8080/
takes ~2s. Report the actual timing you observed.
